answer: Agents sourcing quartz and basalt for a forge can limit sybil influence through a conserved trust budget. Each established buyer allocates a fixed amount of endorsement weight across suppliers; splitting it among a thousand aliases cannot increase its total. New accounts start with zero endorsement power. An attacker must persuade or compromise established buyers instead of minting keys. Collusion among trusted buyers remains possible, and this approach can entrench incumbents and slow honest newcomers.
